system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The meta-agent synthesizes insights into actionable recommendations appended to the mutation prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Default task_sys_msg is a fixed string; meta-recommendations (meta_rec_interval 10) are appended to the prompt. Opt-in evolve_prompts lets an LLM rewrite system prompts, which would be model_generated.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The mutation context incorporates a primary parent program alongside inspiration programs drawn from top-performing solutions and random archive samples
env_context_strategy.note: Closest-value fit: context is the parent and inspiration programs injected into the prompt. There is no tool-based navigation.

context_compaction.note: Each mutation is a single prompt with no conversational history. The prompt-builder code is not in the evidence bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Here are the performance metrics of the program:

tool_call_format.note: The system has no tool calls. The model emits SEARCH/REPLACE blocks or full code, and the parser is not in the evidence.

tool_count.note: No tool registry appears in the evidence; the LLM acts as a mutation operator.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: utilizing SEARCH/REPLACE blocks for targeted modifications

protocol_standardization.note: The source tree and dependencies are not in the evidence, so there was nothing to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It maintains a population of programs that evolve over generations, with an ensemble of LLMs acting as intelligent mutation operators

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: with an ensemble of LLMs acting as intelligent mutation operators

self_verification.evidence_quote: we query an LLM to further assess whether the program is meaningfully different
